name: MP-001: Quarterly CRO Sign-Off
description: Sarah Okonkwo's quarterly sign-off on the consolidated risk report requires manual aggregation from Archer, Piedmont, and Risk Reporting Hub. Marcus Chen's team spends 3-4 days each quarter assembling the package because no single system provides a complete view.

name: MP-002: Daily Wire Transfer Override Sign-Off
description: Daily manual sign-off on wire transfer overrides exceeding $5M. James Patel personally reviews each override against LossDB exception data. The process exists because LossDB's automated threshold alerting does not cover treasury wire exceptions. Only James and Wei Chen understand the full override criteria.

name: MP-003: Monthly Archer-to-Piedmont Reconciliation
description: Monthly reconciliation of RCSA data between Archer and Piedmont Risk Register. Sandra Williams exports both datasets and manually compares risk IDs, control ratings, and assessment dates. Discrepancies average 12-15% per cycle due to independent updates in each system.

name: MP-004: Daily LossDB Triangulation
description: Daily cross-referencing of LossDB loss events against Archer control failures and Risk Reporting Hub aggregates. Deepa Ramaswamy and Brian Foster spend roughly 1.2 FTE combined validating that loss events are properly reflected across all three systems. The 3-5 day lag in the LossDB-to-Reporting-Hub feed means manual bridging is essential.

name: MP-005: Monthly KRI Hub Gap-Fill
description: Monthly manual data entry to compensate for three broken Archer-to-KRI-Hub feeds. Christine Lee manually exports KRI threshold data from Archer and uploads it to the KRI Hub SQL backend. The broken feeds have persisted since the Q3 Archer platform upgrade.

name: MP-006: Archer-to-IssuesPortal Weekly Sync
description: Weekly manual synchronization of issue status between Archer's issue tracking module and IssuesPortal. Priya Sundaram's team exports open issues from both systems and reconciles status, ownership, and due dates. API integration exists but misses approximately 15% of updates due to field mapping gaps.

name: MP-007: Change Log to Change Risk Tool Dual Entry
description: Every change request must be entered into both Change Log (BMC Remedy) and Change Risk Tool (ServiceNow) because the legacy system has not been decommissioned. Kevin Park coordinates the dual-entry process, which consumes an estimated 2.0 FTE across the organization and introduces a 15-20% error rate from manual transcription.

name: MP-008: ERT Parallel Issue Tracker
description: The Enterprise Risk Technology team maintains a shadow Excel spreadsheet tracking approximately 40% of active IssuesPortal items. The tracker adds ERT-specific fields (system impact, remediation complexity, vendor dependency) not available in IssuesPortal. Undocumented process with no formal owner.

name: MP-009: Audit Committee Prep Spreadsheet
description: Quarterly audit committee preparation relies on a master spreadsheet maintained by Liam O'Connor that pulls data from AuditTrack, IssuesPortal, and Archer. The spreadsheet contains custom pivot tables and commentary that exist nowhere else. Only Liam and Jennifer Wright know the full assembly process.

name: MP-010: CRE Concentration Calculation
description: David Krishnamurthy is the sole person who performs the monthly commercial real estate concentration risk calculation. The calculation uses a custom Excel model with proprietary lookup tables that David built over eight years. With David's planned retirement in 18 months, this represents a critical tribal knowledge risk.

name: MP-011: Model Validation Queue Triage
description: Fatima Al-Rashid manually triages the model validation queue, prioritizing validation requests based on model materiality, regulatory deadlines, and resource availability. The prioritization logic exists only in Fatima's institutional knowledge. No written criteria or scoring rubric has been formalized.

name: MP-012: Monthly Vendor Risk Score Compilation
description: Maria Garcia manually compiles vendor risk scores from the Vendor Risk Platform into a summary report for the NPA committee, adding contextual commentary not captured in the platform.

name: MP-013: Weekly Retail Risk Indicator Update
description: Rachel Torres collects retail banking KRIs from branch managers via email and manually enters them into Archer because the branch systems lack direct integration.

name: MP-014: Commercial Lending Risk Aggregation
description: Tom Nguyen aggregates commercial lending exposure data from the loan origination system and manually maps it into the Risk Reporting Hub format for the monthly CRO report.

name: MP-015: Quarterly Scenario Workshop Coordination
description: Ahmed Hassan coordinates the quarterly scenario analysis workshops, manually distributing templates, collecting responses, and loading them into the Scenario Workbench.

name: MP-016: Audit Finding Follow-Up Tracking
description: Jennifer Wright maintains a manual follow-up tracker for overdue audit findings, cross-referencing AuditTrack deadlines with IssuesPortal remediation status.

name: MP-017: IT Risk Exception Log
description: Daniel Brown maintains a supplementary spreadsheet of IT risk exceptions that cannot be captured in Archer's standard taxonomy, covering cloud configuration risks and API security findings.

name: MP-018: Regulatory Report Data Validation
description: Michael Zhang performs manual validation of regulatory report data by comparing Risk Reporting Hub outputs against source system extracts before each regulatory filing.

name: MP-019: BCP Test Result Compilation
description: Nancy Stewart manually compiles business continuity plan test results from multiple departments into a consolidated report for the risk committee.

name: MP-020: Wealth Management Risk Dashboard Update
description: Lisa Campbell manually updates the wealth management risk dashboard by extracting data from Archer and combining it with proprietary suitability metrics tracked in a departmental spreadsheet.

name: MP-021: Compliance Risk Mapping Refresh
description: Patricia Moore refreshes the compliance risk mapping between regulatory requirements and Archer control IDs on a quarterly basis, manually updating cross-references.

name: MP-022: Daily Risk Event Triage
description: Wei Chen's team triages incoming operational risk events each morning, classifying them and routing to the appropriate system (LossDB, IssuesPortal, or Archer) based on event type and severity.

name: MP-023: NPA Risk Assessment Coordination
description: Maria Garcia coordinates risk assessment inputs from multiple departments for new product approvals, manually consolidating feedback into the NPA System workflow.

name: MP-024: Risk Reporting Hub Data Refresh Validation
description: Robert Kim validates the daily data refresh in Risk Reporting Hub by spot-checking key metrics against source system values, flagging discrepancies for investigation.

name: MP-025: Monthly Board Risk Report Assembly
description: Marcus Chen assembles the monthly board risk report by pulling data from Risk Reporting Hub, adding CRO commentary, and formatting the final presentation. The process requires manual data pulls from three additional sources not connected to the Hub.

name: MP-026: Piedmont Historical Data Lookup
description: When historical risk assessments predating 2017 are needed for regulatory inquiries, Deepa Ramaswamy manually searches the Piedmont Risk Register and extracts the relevant records.
